pages.title: Play It Your Way
pages.text: Play a bundled melody and a keyboard-mode note on an instrument.

pages.title: Play It Your Way
pages.text: Move from opening an instrument to performing; a triangle expands the sound and chairs seat listeners.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The instrument screen provides search, favorites, pause and MIDI track choice. Custom .midi/.abc uses its native drop zone or melody directory+refresh; server upload permissions apply and importing is optional.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Collect a copper ingot. Unlock instrument recipes in the vanilla recipe book.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Select and play a bundled song using one of the mod's instruments. Perform music in multiplayer.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Drag supported MIDI or ABC files into the in-game import flow; use MIDI files for a datapack. Add a custom melody to the available repertoire.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Switch the instrument screen to keyboard play rather than a stored melody. Play notes from the keyboard; bundled/native UI also supports search, favorites, track list and pause.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the melody screen sheet/track control when an imported MIDI contains several instrumental tracks. Select the intended notes instead of relying on automatic track choice; other-player uploads and mob instrument pickup/spawns follow server configuration.
